一般现在时.规则: 表示经常性或习惯性的动作。第三人称单数动词加-s/-es
例句: I get up at 7 o'clock every day.
She goes to school by bus.
We have English class on Monday.
The sun rises in the east.

现在进行时.规则: 表示正在进行的动作（be + doing）
例句: I am reading a book now.

一般过去时.规则: 表示过去发生的动作（动词加-ed或不规则变化）
例句: I went to the park yesterday.
We had a party last night.

一般将来时.规则: 表示将要发生的动作（will + 动词原形 / be going to + 动词原形）
例句: I will go to Beijing tomorrow.
She is going to visit her friend.
We will have a test next week.
They are going to move house.

现在完成时.规则: 表示过去发生的动作对现在的影响（have/has + done）
例句: We have lived here for 10 years.
How long have you studied English?

情态动词.规则: can/could/may/might/must/should/would 等表示能力、许可、建议、义务等

比较级.规则: 形容词比较级：一般加-er，多音节加more；最高级：一般加-est，多音节加most
例句: This is the most beautiful city.
My bag is bigger than yours.
English is more difficult than math.
